## MSc Thesis | Validation of a Post-Stroke Cognitive Assessment in fMRI 
### Ongoing
#### Supervised by Professors Hans Op de Beeck, Celine Gillebert, and PhD student Emma Goris
Developed a literature review on the five cognitive domains assessed; assisted with fMRI data collection; used MATLAB to run data analyses; findings to be expressed in the form of a written article; will complete an oral defense. 

\

## BA Independent Honors Thesis | Autistic Traits and Gender Identity
#### Supervised by Professors Gilian Tenbergen and Karin Wolford
Developed a literature review of research on autism and gender identity; identified knowledge gaps and formed hypotheses; constructed Qualtrics survey; created and maintained data spreadsheets; analyzed data in IBM SPSS; expressed findings in the form of a written article and oral presentation at the 2022 Quest Research Symposium.
